core_obligations: The equivalence Mod_A/T \cong Vect_K restricts along the embedding Mod_A^{fg}/T^{fg} -> Mod_A/T to an equivalence onto Vect_K^{fd}

Noetherianity guarantees Mod_A^{fg} is abelian (More on Algebra section reference) and that the canonical functor Mod_A^{fg}/T^{fg} -> Mod_A/T is full: otherwise torsion submodules of finitely generated modules could fall outside T^{fg}
